title: County Executive Director Expanded — Farm Service Agency
summary: This is a County Executive Director Expanded position located in the Sanpete County Farm Service Agency Office, in Ephraim, Utah. Per 27-PM, Par. 472E, this vacancy is being advertised with an expanded area of consideration. $40,736–$116,362 per year

title: FUL-Field Staff Law Enforcement Ranger — Bureau of Land Management
summary: You will serve as a FUL-Field Staff Law Enforcement Ranger for the Bureau of Land Management Green River District. The Law Enforcement Ranger serves as a uniformed representative who enforces federal laws and regulations on public lands, including supporting agency presence in the community. You may be required to work on-call, evenings, weekends, holidays, overtime and shift work. · $58,771–$84,5
